title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
summary:
Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, hailed as the world’s most advanced models for coding, knowledge work, and scientific research. These models share the same core capabilities but differ in safeguards: Fable 5.1 is generally available, while Mythos 5.1, with specialized safeguards for cybersecurity and life sciences, is accessible through trusted programs.

Fable 5.1 introduces significant improvements based on customer feedback. Pricing is reduced by an estimated 25% for typical workloads (up to 45% for agentic work) due to lower cache read costs. A new Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) system will offer complete data privacy (zero data retention) by storing data in customer-controlled cloud infrastructure, with immediate zero data retention available for eligible customers until EFS launches. Safeguards are enhanced, reducing false positives by 60% in cybersecurity and allowing for software vulnerability discovery. A biology access program for Mythos 5.1 is also being established in partnership with the US government.

Performance-wise, Fable 5.1 sets a new standard, outperforming its predecessor, Fable 5, across coding, knowledge work, and long-running tasks. It achieves higher scores on benchmarks like Terminal-Bench-Science and Terminal-Bench 4.0, often at lower costs when set to lower effort levels. Customer testimonials highlight its ability to solve deeply complex problems, improve code review efficiency, enhance creative problem-solving, and offer more readable, concise outputs, making it a powerful upgrade for various demanding applications.
chinese_title: 克劳德寓言5.1 和 克劳德神话5.1
chinese_summary:
Anthropic公司发布了Claude Fable 5.1和Claude Mythos 5.1，这些模型被誉为全球最先进的编码、知识工作和科学研究模型。它们共享相同的核心能力，但在安全防护方面有所不同：Fable 5.1已普遍可用，而Mythos 5.1则配备了网络安全和生命科学领域的专业安全防护措施，可通过受信任的计划获取。

Fable 5.1基于客户反馈引入了显著改进。由于缓存读取成本降低，典型工作负载的定价预计降低25%（代理工作最高可达45%）。新的企业前沿安全防护系统（EFS）将通过将数据存储在客户控制的云基础设施中，提供彻底的数据隐私（零数据保留），在EFS系统推出前，符合条件的客户可立即享受零数据保留。安全防护措施得到增强，将网络安全领域的误报率降低了60%，并支持软件漏洞的发现。此外，Anthropic正与美国政府合作，为Mythos 5.1建立生物学访问计划。

在性能方面，Fable 5.1树立了新标准，在编码、知识工作和长时间运行任务方面均优于其前身Fable 5。它在Terminal-Bench-Science和Terminal-Bench 4.0等基准测试中取得了更高的分数，并且在较低工作量设置下通常成本更低。客户评价强调了其解决极其复杂问题、提高代码审查效率、增强创造性解决问题的能力，以及提供更易读、更简洁的输出，使其成为各种高要求应用的强大升级。

title: Hang on to Your Firefox
summary:
The article, dated August 31, 2026, urges readers to "Hang on to your Firefox," applying the adage "Don’t throw the baby out with the bathwater" to discourage abandoning a crucial resource over minor grievances. The author critiques those "dumping on Firefox," such as a blogger who switched to Vivaldi due to Firefox's presence on X, despite Vivaldi also being on X and other major platforms like Meta and Google. Similarly, the article dismisses "convoluted reasons" for disliking Firefox often found on Hacker News.

The central argument is that Firefox is "our last best hope for browser engine diversity and competition." Without it, the internet would be dominated by Google Chrome and its numerous spin-offs, with Apple Safari being the only independent browser solely due to its default status on iPhones. The author suggests Firefox's efforts, such as being on X, are a necessary attempt to reach new users and combat its "small and diminishing market share." Ultimately, the piece calls for users to support Firefox, recognizing its vital role in fostering competition and innovation on the web.
chinese_title: 守住你的 Firefox
chinese_summary:
这篇发布于2026年8月31日的文章，敦促读者“坚守Firefox”，引用“不要把洗澡水和孩子一起倒掉”这句格言，旨在劝阻人们不要因为细枝末节的不满而放弃一个至关重要的资源。作者批评那些“抛弃Firefox”的人，例如一位博主因为Firefox在X平台上的存在而转投Vivaldi，尽管Vivaldi也存在于X以及Meta和Google等其他主要平台。同样，文章驳斥了那些常在Hacker News上出现的对Firefox不屑一顾的“牵强附会的理由”。

核心论点是，Firefox是“我们实现浏览器引擎多样性和竞争的最后也是最好的希望”。没有它，互联网将由Google Chrome及其众多衍生产品主导，而Apple Safari则仅仅因为其在iPhone上的默认地位，才成为唯一一款独立的浏览器。作者认为，Firefox在X平台等方面的努力是一种必要的尝试，旨在触达新用户，并应对其“微薄且不断缩小的市场份额”。最终，这篇文章呼吁用户支持Firefox，认识到它在促进网络竞争和创新方面所扮演的关键角色。

title: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
summary:
AnkiDroid, a popular free flashcard app, is facing removal from Google Play by September 11, 2026, due to Google's payments policy regarding external donation links. The app directs users to Open Collective for donations, whose fiscal host, Open Source Collective, holds a US IRS 501(c)(6) tax-exempt status.

Google's policy permits external links for "tax exempt donations" but initially cited 501(c)(3) as an example of a validated tax-exempt organization. After AnkiDroid provided proof of its 501(c)(6) status, Google repeatedly stated the organization "is not tax-exempt" without explaining why 501(c)(6) is insufficient, despite it being a recognized tax-exempt status for the organization (though donations are not tax-deductible for donors).

AnkiDroid, a volunteer-maintained project relying solely on these donations, has been forced to remove the donation links from its Play Store build under protest to prevent the app's delisting, with updates being rejected since August 28, 2026. They are seeking clarification from Google on whether 501(c)(6) satisfies the "tax exempt donations" criterion and urge readers to share their plight, especially with Google employees, but not to contact Google support directly.
chinese_title: AnkiDroid：Google Play 不再允许 Open Collective 捐赠链接
chinese_summary:
AnkiDroid，一款广受欢迎的免费抽认卡应用，因Google关于外部捐款链接的支付政策，面临自2026年9月11日起从Google Play下架的命运。该应用引导用户前往Open Collective进行捐款，其财务托管方Open Source Collective拥有美国国税局（IRS）501(c)(6)免税地位。

Google的政策允许“免税捐款”的外部链接，但最初将501(c)(3)列为经过验证的免税组织的示例。在AnkiDroid提供了其501(c)(6)地位证明后，Google却反复声明该组织“不免税”，且未解释为何501(c)(6)不符合要求，尽管这是该组织公认的免税地位（尽管对捐赠者而言，捐款不可抵税）。

AnkiDroid是一个由志愿者维护的项目，仅依靠这些捐款维持运营。为了防止应用下架，该项目已被迫在抗议下从其Play商店版本中删除了捐款链接，自2026年8月28日以来，其更新一直遭到拒绝。他们正在向Google寻求澄清，以确定501(c)(6)是否符合“免税捐款”的标准，并呼吁读者分享他们的困境，尤其是与Google员工分享，但不要直接联系Google客服。

title: How accurate have Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions been?
summary:
The article evaluates the accuracy of Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions, with the author stating a neutral stance on AI progress, motivated by a desire for accuracy, and having no significant financial interest in AI companies.

The author details Zitron's November 2024 prediction that major tech companies like Meta, Google, and Microsoft are "dying" and are "thrashing around" with AI due to an inability to grow. The article counters this by presenting the actual revenue and profit growth of these companies for 2023-2026, showing significant increases, directly contradicting Zitron's "dying ecosystem" claim. The author criticizes Zitron's reasoning, pointing out cherry-picked data (e.g., using inaccurate third-party MAU figures for Meta instead of company reports) and flawed arguments about Google Search issues that don't account for other growth drivers like YouTube and Google Cloud.

The author, along with other commentators like Juho Snellman and Timothy B. Lee, widely critiques Zitron's general methodology. They assert that Zitron's use of numbers is often misleading, misrepresented, or contains factual errors (e.g., miscalculating Anthropic's revenue projections). The consensus is that Zitron's arguments often lack coherence, relying on "sleight of hand" with numbers and anger to drive engagement rather than sound analysis.

A list of Zitron's specific predictions from Feb 2024 to Feb 2025 is provided, including claims that generative AI has reached its upper limits, cannot improve due to data exhaustion, and that OpenAI's growth is stalling or its revenue forecasts are absurd. The article consistently marks these predictions as "Wrong," citing continued model improvements, rapid growth for AI companies like OpenAI, and the surpassing of user targets (e.g., Gemini hitting 750M users against Zitron's "unrealistic" 500M prediction).

In conclusion, the article finds Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions to be consistently inaccurate, both in their outcomes and the flawed reasoning supporting them.
chinese_title: 埃德·齐特隆的AI怀疑论预测有多准确？
chinese_summary:
本文评估了Ed Zitron对AI持怀疑态度的预测的准确性。作者声明对AI进展持中立立场，其动机是追求准确性，且在AI公司中没有重大利益关系。

作者详细阐述了Zitron在2024年11月的预测，即Meta、谷歌和微软等大型科技公司“正在消亡”，并且由于无法实现增长，正在“围绕AI挣扎”。文章通过展示这些公司2023-2026年的实际收入和利润增长来反驳这一观点，显示出显著增长，直接驳斥了Zitron关于“生态系统正在消亡”的说法。作者批评了Zitron的论证，指出其选择性地使用数据（例如，使用不准确的第三方MAU数据而不是公司报告来评估Meta），以及关于谷歌搜索问题的缺陷论点，未能考虑到YouTube和谷歌云等其他增长驱动因素。

作者与其他评论员，如Juho Snellman和Timothy B. Lee，广泛批评了Zitron的总体方法论。他们断言Zitron对数字的使用常常具有误导性、被歪曲或包含事实错误（例如，错误计算Anthropic的收入预测）。共识是Zitron的论点常常缺乏连贯性，依赖于数字上的“花招”和煽动愤怒来吸引关注，而非扎实的分析。

文章列出了Zitron从2024年2月到2025年2月的一些具体预测，包括生成式AI已达到上限、因数据枯竭而无法改进、以及OpenAI增长停滞或其收入预测荒谬等说法。文章始终将这些预测标记为“错误”，理由是模型持续改进、OpenAI等AI公司迅速增长、以及用户目标被超越（例如，Gemini用户达到7.5亿，而Zitron的预测是“不切实际”的5亿）。

总之，文章认为Ed Zitron对AI持怀疑态度的预测，无论从结果还是支撑它们的有缺陷的论证来看，都始终不准确。

title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
summary:
Google has removed all Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions, including prominent ad-blockers like uBlock Origin, from the Chrome Web Store. This action, implemented in June 2024, concludes Google's lengthy transition to the new Manifest V3 (MV3) extension platform, following several delays from its initial deprecation timeline. While users with existing MV2 extensions might still have them operational, new installations or updates from the store are no longer possible.

Google asserts that MV3 enhances security, privacy, and performance by requiring extensions to explicitly declare permissions and utilize a more restricted API model. However, critics, especially within the ad-blocking community, argue that MV3 severely limits the capabilities of content blockers. The new `declarativeNetRequest` API replaces the more powerful `webRequest` API, which was crucial for sophisticated ad-blocking, leading to less effective MV3-compliant blockers. uBlock Origin's developer, Raymond Hill, has voiced strong concerns, stating that a full-featured uBlock Origin is not viable under MV3, acknowledging its "Lite" version as a compromise.

This shift has prompted users concerned about ad-blocking efficacy to consider alternative browsers like Firefox, Brave, and Edge, which are committed to maintaining support for more robust ad-blocking functionalities, diverging from Chrome's MV3 restrictions.
chinese_title: 谷歌已将MV2扩展从Chrome网上应用店下架，其中包括UBO
chinese_summary:
Google已将所有Manifest V2 (MV2) 扩展程序，包括uBlock Origin等知名广告拦截器，从Chrome网上应用店中移除。此举于2024年6月实施，标志着Google向新的Manifest V3 (MV3) 扩展平台漫长过渡的终结，该过渡在最初的弃用时间表上经历了多次延迟。虽然现有MV2扩展程序的用户可能仍能使其正常运行，但已无法从商店进行新的安装或更新。

Google声称，MV3通过要求扩展程序明确声明权限并使用更受限制的API模型来增强安全性、隐私性和性能。然而，批评者，特别是广告拦截社区内部的批评者认为，MV3严重限制了内容拦截器的功能。新的`declarativeNetRequest` API取代了功能更强大的`webRequest` API，后者对于复杂的广告拦截至关重要，导致符合MV3标准的拦截器效果不佳。uBlock Origin的开发者Raymond Hill表达了强烈担忧，指出在MV3下，功能齐全的uBlock Origin无法运行，并承认其“精简版”(Lite) 是一种妥协。

这一转变促使关注广告拦截效果的用户考虑使用Firefox、Brave和Edge等替代浏览器，这些浏览器致力于维护对更强大广告拦截功能的支持，与Chrome的MV3限制背道而驰。

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
summary:
On September 2, 2026, Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber, their third Flash release in six weeks, aimed at next-generation agentic workflows and cybersecurity.

Gemini 3.8 Flash is presented as Google's "best reasoning & coding model yet," delivering significant improvements over 3.7 Flash in software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning, at the same low cost ($0.75 input, $3.75 output per million tokens). It approaches the performance of higher-cost frontier models, excelling in benchmarks like DeepSWE v1.1 and HLE-Verified, by "working harder" through extra reasoning steps and iterative tool calls. It's available to developers via API, enterprises, and Google AI Pro/Ultra consumers.

Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is Google's "most capable cybersecurity model," offering frontier-level performance in autonomous vulnerability discovery and automated patching. Available exclusively to "trusted defenders" through the new Fairwind Program, it outperforms previous models and larger frontier models on benchmarks like CyberGym for discovery and CWE-Bench for patching (47.2% pass@1). It has demonstrated real-world impact by securing Google's code, including Chrome and Cloud, with better patch accuracy and faster vulnerability discovery. The model prioritizes defensive capabilities.

Both models are built on the same foundational intelligence, accelerated by agentic loops, and feature enhanced prompt injection robustness. They include safeguards against misuse, with Flash Cyber having more permissive mitigations tailored for trusted cybersecurity experts.
chinese_title: 双子 3.8 闪 和 3.8 闪 赛博
chinese_summary:
2026年9月2日，Google推出了Gemini 3.8 Flash和3.8 Flash Cyber，这是他们六周内发布的第三款Flash模型，旨在支持下一代智能体工作流和网络安全。

Gemini 3.8 Flash被誉为Google“迄今为止最佳的推理与编码模型”，相比3.7 Flash在软件工程、智能体任务和多步骤推理方面取得了显著进步，同时保持相同的低成本（每百万token输入0.75美元，输出3.75美元）。它的性能接近成本更高的前沿模型，通过额外的推理步骤和迭代工具调用，“更努力地工作”，在DeepSWE v1.1和HLE-Verified等基准测试中表现出色。开发者可通过API、企业用户以及Google AI Pro/Ultra用户使用该模型。

Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber是Google“功能最强大的网络安全模型”，在自主漏洞发现和自动化补丁修复方面提供了前沿水平的性能。该模型通过新的Fairwind计划，专供“可信防御者”使用，在CyberGym漏洞发现和CWE-Bench补丁修复等基准测试中（补丁修复通过率达47.2%）超越了之前的模型和更大的前沿模型。它通过更高的补丁准确性和更快的漏洞发现速度，保护了Google的代码（包括Chrome和Cloud），展现了实际应用价值。该模型优先考虑防御能力。

这两款模型均基于相同的底层智能，通过智能体循环加速，并增强了对抗提示注入的鲁棒性。它们包含防止滥用的安全措施，其中Flash Cyber具有更宽松的缓解措施，专为可信的网络安全专家量身定制。

title: True Rate of Unemployment
summary:
The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) has developed the "True Rate of Unemployment" (TRU) to offer a more accurate gauge of Americans' financial well-being compared to the official government statistics. LISEP defines "functional unemployment" to include U.S. labor force members who lack a full-time job (35+ hours/week) but desire one, are jobless, or do not earn a living wage (conservatively set at $26,000 annually before taxes in 2025 dollars).

Using federal Bureau of Labor Statistics data, LISEP reported the TRU at 24.9% for July 2026, a stark contrast to the Headline Rate of Unemployment of 4.1%. This figure represented a 0.2 percentage point increase and the fourth consecutive monthly rise. LISEP stresses the importance of such indicators for policymakers to shape economic policy effectively.

The TRU also highlights significant disparities across demographics for July 2026:
*   **Race:** Black individuals faced the highest TRU at 27.3%, followed by Hispanic (26.7%), and White (23.8%).
*   **Sex:** Women experienced a substantially higher TRU at 31.0% compared to men at 19.5%.
*   **Education:** Functional unemployment inversely correlated with education, ranging from 50.3% for those with no high school diploma to 12.8% for those with an advanced degree.

LISEP provides further details on the TRU methodology and data in its white papers and additional resources.
chinese_title: True Rate of Unemployment
chinese_summary:
共享经济繁荣路德维希研究所（LISEP）开发了“真实失业率”（TRU），旨在比官方政府统计数据更准确地衡量美国人的财务状况。LISEP将“功能性失业”定义为包括那些没有全职工作（每周35小时以上）但希望获得全职工作的、失业的、或未赚取生活工资（保守地设定为2025年美元，税前年薪26,000美元）的美国劳动力成员。

利用联邦劳工统计局的数据，LISEP报告称2026年7月的TRU为24.9%，与4.1%的总体失业率形成鲜明对比。这一数字代表了0.2个百分点的增长，也是连续第四个月的上升。LISEP强调这些指标对于政策制定者有效制定经济政策的重要性。

TRU还揭示了2026年7月各人口群体之间的显著差异：
*   **种族：** 黑人面临的TRU最高，为27.3%，其次是西班牙裔（26.7%）和白人（23.8%）。
*   **性别：** 女性的TRU为31.0%，远高于男性的19.5%。
*   **教育程度：** 功能性失业与教育程度呈负相关，从没有高中毕业文凭的人群的50.3%到拥有高级学位的人群的12.8%不等。

LISEP在其白皮书和补充资料中提供了TRU方法论和数据的进一步详细信息。
